anna: Heads-up: PR #2104 changed the error example in the OpenAPI for POST /v1/generate. The example now shows `error.code: 429` (number) but our schema defines `code` as a string (enum). This makes openapi-lint fail and will break some SDKs. cc @peter @zu

peter: Link?

anna: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2104 - author said they mirrored what the runtime logs use (numeric HTTP-like codes) but our public API historically uses string error codes like "rate_limit_exceeded".

zu: Yup that'll fail validation. We should keep canonical example matching the schema (string code). If runtime returns numeric codes for some internal errors, we should document that as a compatibility note and show how to map.

docs-bot: openapi-lint: example/type-mismatch: /components/examples/ErrorResponse.code expected string but found integer (example 429).

peter: Proposal: revert the example to use the canonical string code value, e.g., "code": "rate_limit_exceeded". Add a short note in the errors section: "Some internal deployments may emit numeric HTTP-like codes in the `code` field; clients should prefer the string enum and map numeric codes where needed." Include tiny mapping snippets for JS and Go.

anna: I'll update the PR: revert example, add the compatibility note, and include mapping helpers. For JS: `const code = typeof err.code === 'number' ? mapNumCode(err.code) : err.code;` and for Go: `switch v := err.Code.(type) { case float64: code = mapNumCode(int(v)); case string: code = v }` with brief comment about json.Decoder defaulting numbers to float64.

zu: Good. Also add a test fixture in examples/fixtures/error-both.json with both variants and a small example test that ensures examples-validate flags mismatches.

docs-bot: ci/checks: openapi-lint failing until canonical example matches schema.

anna: Pushed changes: reverted example to string, added note + snippets, added fixture, wired examples-validate. Ping for quick review.

peter: Quick nit: in Go snippet maybe show `json.Number` handling or `UseNumber` to avoid float64 surprise. But the pattern you have is fine with a short comment.

zu: LGTM. CI green?

docs-bot: ci/checks: examples-validate passed. openapi-lint passed.

anna: Merged. Added one-line changelog: "Docs: align error response example code type with schema and add mapping guidance for numeric codes." Closing thread.
